full_judgment: 2. The case of the petitioner, in brief, is that the predecessor of the opposite party Nos.1-16, Sadek Hossain Howlader since deceased as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 285 of 1971 in the court of the subordinate Judge, Barisal for declaration of title against the opposite party Nos. 17-22 over the land described in the schedule of the plaint contending inter alia, that one Omesh Chandra Hajra, the predecessor of defendant- opposite party Nos. 17-21 being the owner of the suit land settled the same to the plaintiff in Kole-Karsha on 13th Choitra, 1950 B.S. at an annual rental of Tk. 18/- and on receipt of selaim granted rent receipts to the plaintiffs as recognition of the tenancy .since then the plaintiff had been possessing the suit land adversely against others. Thereafter the suit land having not been recorded in the name of the plaintiff he could not pay rent to the Government and it clouded his title and the plaintiff came to know of the said wrong record in Baisakh, 1376 B.S. corresponding to 20.04.1969 and hence the suit.
